ETV Bharat, 21 February 2026, on the final roll

notes: Every figure here is the Chief Electoral Officer's as printed in the press. The draft figures come from Dainik Jagran on 23 December 2025 and the final roll from Dainik Bhaskar and ETV Bharat on 21 February 2026.

The Chief Electoral Officer's website lists three press notes on the revision, the note on the draft in English and in Hindi and the note on the final roll. None of the three is available there, and no archived copy was found.
The five reasons as printed add to 42,74,142, which is 18 fewer than the 42,74,160 names left off. They are shown as printed.
Shifted, absent or other is 8,42,677 absent, 22,78,393 permanently shifted and 29,927 other.

The notices figure is the 8,65,832 electors kept on the draft whose enumeration forms were incomplete and who were to be served notices. One report gave 8,46,184 as the unmapped count, but that is the number of dead electors and is not used.
The roll before is the roll frozen on 25 October 2025 for the revision. The roll on 6 January 2025 was 5,70,92,367.

The final roll was 8,49,082 more than the draft. Gross additions and deletions after the draft were not reported. The press reported 9,89,991 applications to add names after the draft, which is not the number admitted.
The final roll by sex was reported only as shares, 51.69 per cent men and 48.30 per cent women, with 904 third gender electors.
For two more constituencies with large removals, the press article names the elected member and leaves out the seat. Those two figures are left out because the seat had to be inferred.
